title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. STEP-UPS ON THE BOTTOM STAIR, REVERSE LUNGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE, THEN HIP FLEXOR, HAMSTRING, AND WALL CHEST OPENERS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. STEP UPS, LUNGES, A BALANCE HINGE, THEN WE OPEN THE HIPS, THE HAMSTRINGS, AND THE CHEST. THE WEEKEND IS OVER, SUNSHINE. YOUR LEGS HAVE BEEN ON HOLIDAY. HOLIDAY IS CANCELLED.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. THAT INBOX CAN WAIT, IT'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LEGS WORKED, LUNGS OPENED, HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS AND CHEST LOOSENED. GOOD START TO THE WEEK. NOW GO SIT IN THAT CHAIR LIKE A MAN WITH A SPINE, NOT A BLOODY QUESTION MARK.

exercises.name: STAIR STEP-UP
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. TEN ON ONE LEG, THEN TEN ON THE OTHER. HAND ON THE RAIL IS LEGAL. STEADY PACE — BREATHING UP, NOT GASPING.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. THREE SETS. TEN EACH LEG. BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. THIS IS THE LUNGS BIT, SO BREATHE LIKE YOU MEAN IT, NOT LIKE A BLOODY ACCORDION WITH A PUNCTURE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS OUT. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. LEGS AWAKE. LUNGS AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES ARE SOFTLY BENT — BACK KNEE TOWARD THE FLOOR, NOT SLAMMING IT. FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. EIGHT EACH LEG. FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR OR WALL IS LEGAL. PARTIAL DEPTH IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGE. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. STEP BACK. LOWER SOFT. FRONT HEEL DRIVES YOU UP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE IS FINE. FALLING OVER LIKE A DRUNK AT A WEDDING IS NOT.
exercises.speakDone: LUNGES DONE. STRONG LEGS. GOOD LAD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, KNEE SOFT. HINGE AT THE HIP, TIPPING THE CHEST FORWARD AS THE FREE LEG REACHES STRAIGHT BACK — LIKE A SEE-SAW. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CAN STAY STEADY. RETURN TALL. SIX EACH LEG. FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR OR WALL ARE LEGAL. HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. ONE LEG. TIP FORWARD. BACK LEG REACHES LONG. HIPS SQUARE. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. A SEE SAW, NOT A COLLAPSING DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH LEGS WHEN READY. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER THAN LAST MONTH. I NOTICED. GOOD.

exercises.name: HALF-KNEELING HIP FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: KNEEL ON ONE KNEE (CUSHION OR FOLDED JUMPER UNDER IT), OTHER FOOT FLAT IN FRONT, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. STAND THE TORSO TALL. GENTLY TUCK THE TAILBONE AND SHIFT THE HIPS A TOUCH FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH AT THE FRONT OF THE DOWN-LEG HIP. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK. HAND ON A CHAIR TO GET DOWN AND UP IS LEGAL.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ONE KNEE DOWN. TALL CHEST. TUCK THE TAIL. HIPS FORWARD A TOUCH. GENTLE. THAT CHAIR HAS SHRUNK THE FRONT OF YOUR HIPS LIKE A WOOLLY JUMPER ON A HOT WASH. STRETCH IT BACK OUT.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: PLACE ONE HEEL ON A LOW STAIR, LEG MOSTLY STRAIGHT, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS WITH A LONG SPINE UNTIL YOU FEEL A GENTLE STRETCH IN THE BACK OF THE THIGH. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH LEGS. NO BOUNCING. BREATHE INTO THE STRETCH.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE STEP. HINGE. LONG SPINE. NO BOUNCING. THOSE HAMSTRINGS JUST DID A SHIFT. PAY THEM.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE FOREARM AND OPEN PALM ON THE WALL AT ABOUT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW SOFT. STEP THE SAME-SIDE FOOT FORWARD A TOUCH AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH ACROSS THE CHEST AND FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH SIDES. NO FORCING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. OPEN THOSE SHOULDERS BEFORE THAT KEYBOARD HUNCHES YOU INTO A BLOODY TORTOISE AGAIN.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
